items.text: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ase engaki egocha, inche nimbe Nyasae bw’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli, na barabwo nababe abanto baane.”
Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Abanto abwo batooregete korwa ase ogoitwa nemioro, mbanyorete amaabera agwo ase erooro. Ekero Abaisraeli baganetie banyore obotoereru,
inche Omonene nkabaorokera korwa aare. Nabeire mbanchete nobwanchani bwa kare na kare. Ase ayio obuya bwane bwa botambe bwabang’usire.
Naende inwe Abaisraeli, abamore ase ’nde buna omoiseke omwekungi, nimbaagache nainwe moagacheke, mokong’e. Inwe namwechabere chinchigiri naende, erio mochenge mogotenga amo nabwo bagochenga.
Mosimeke emesabibu ase emegondo y’ebitunwa bia Samaria. Abwo barasimeke nabarie okwama okwo.
Rituko ngocha rire ekero abarendi bararangerie korwa ase ense y’ebigoro y’Efraimu, bateebe: Imoka togende Sayoni ase Omonene Nyasae oito.”
“Tera neriogi ri’omogooko ase engencho y’abanto ba Yakobo,
moake amariogi ase engencho yaye oyore omonene bw’ebisaku.
Raria na goaka ng’a mbuya mono, erio motebe:
Rora, nimbarente korwa ase ense ya sugusu,
Amo nabarabwo mbachiche emeuko na ebirema,
abakungu bare barito na abakobina baibore,
nabairane aase aiga bare omoganda omonene.
korende inche nimbatang’ane mbairanie gocha bagosaba.
mbaeterie ase enchera engiya ase batagochwe.
morirarie ase ebisinka na ase chinse
chi’aare echire ang’e ne chinyancha, motebe:
ere nabarisie buna omorisia akorisia ching’ondi chiaye.
obatooririe korwa ase amaboko ’abaanto bare ne chinguru kobabua.
Nabachiche bagotera neriogi rinene igoro y’egetunwa gia Sayoni;
gochia ase endagera, na edivai, na amaguta ’amazeituni,
na ase chimanwa chi’eching’ondi, na echie chimbori, ne chimori chi’echiombe.
Obogima bwabo nabobe buna omogondo ogoitororerwa amaache;
Erio abaiseke abekungi mbatenge na bagoke,
abanto abake na abagotu nababe nomogooko.
Ninyigotie na goisanekia abakuani n’ebinto ebinoru;
tancheti aremigwe ase engencho y’abana baye,
ekiagera emeremo yao nenyorerwe eng’eria yaye,
abwo nabairane korwa ase ense y’ababisa babo,
Ogosemeria nkore asore ase amatuko agochi‐gocha,
na abana bao nabairane gocha ase ense yabo.
na inche narongeire buna emori etorokereiri,
Irana inwe Abaisraeli abamore buna omoiseke omwekungi,
Omonene natonge ring’ana riyia ase ense,
Ogosesenigwa kw’abaanto ba Nyasae ase amatuko agochi‐gocha
Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: “Ekero ndairanerie abanto bairetwe obosomba amaya abo, nabakwane naende amang’ana aya ase ense y’Abayuda na ase emechie ereo:
Abayuda mbamenye ase emechie yabo yonsi amo. Boigo abaremi na abarisia baria bakona‐koong’anya mbamenyeo.
Nintimokie na goisanekia abanto abwo barosire; na kera omonto ogoyire nimoisanekie na komoigotia.”
(Aroro agwo nkaboka korwa ase chitoro, nkarigereria, ne chitoro chiane nigo chiarenge chingiya ase ’nde.)
Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Amatuko ngocha are, ekero inche ndabusure ense y’Abaisraeli, na ey’Abayuda, ne chimbusuro chia Mwanyabaanto na echie ching’iti.
Buna nabeire mbarigereretie ase okobasimora, na kobatagora, na kobaonchorana, na kobasiria, na kobarentera amabe, naboigo ndabarigererie ase okobaagacha na kobasimeka. Nabo inche Omonene natebiire.
Ekero amatuko aria araike, tibagokwana iga nonya ng’ake:
Kera omonto nigo arakwe ase engencho y’obobe bwaye omonyene. Kera omonto orarie amasabibu amaroro, amaino aye nabe nobokang’iti.
Omonene oteebire iga: “Rora, amatuko ngocha are, ekero ndakore okobwatana okoyia kw’ogotianania nenyomba y’Abaisraeli na ey’Abayuda.

Okobwatana okwo tigokoba buna koria nakorete ne chisokoro chiabo, ekero nabarusetie nokoboko kwane korwa ase ense ya Misiri, okwo basaretie nonya inche narenge buna omosacha obo.” Nab’Omonene atebiire.

Naende Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Oko nakwo okobwatana ndakore n’Abaisraeli magega y’amatuko ayio: Nimbeke amachiiko aane ime yabo; ninyarike ase chinkoro chiabo. Inche nimbe Nyasae obo, na barabwo mbabe abanto baane.

Engaki eyio tibakogenderera kworokererania, kera omonto ogoteebia omogisangio oye, gose oyomwabo: Many’Omonene, ekiagera bonsi pi nabamanye inche, korwa omonto omoke mono goika omonene mono. Inche nimbaabere obobe bwabo; tinkoinyora ebibe biabo nonya ng’ake,” Nab’Omonene atebiire.
ere oyio ogoserokia enyancha erinde yaeera,
Omoroberio oyo obekirwe ase ebinto ebio oise korusigwa ase ’nde,
tibakoba egesaku ase obosio bwane kogenderera botambe.”
na amaroso ’ense aise gotukwa na komanyekana buna ere,
ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio onsi bakorire.”
Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Amatuko ngocha are ekero omochie oria oraagachwe naende ase ’nde, gochakera ase Omorobiri o Hananeli goikera ase Egeita gi’Ekoona.
Orobebe rwaye rw’okoyorenga narogende aare, rorongee gochia ase ekegoro kia Garebu, naende roonchoke rogende roike Goa.

Rikura rionsi rire nemebere ekwete, ne ribu, amo nemegondo yonsi ere agwo goikera akarooche ga Kidironi, na goika ekoona ekorokwa Egeita gie Chibarasi, gochia ase ensemo ya moocha; chinsemo echio nchibe chinchenu ase ’nde inche Omonene. Tichikoonchoranwa gose gosarigwa nonya ng’ake.”
